competences.description: Attacks the enemy to stun for 1 turn with a 30% chance.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.

competences.description: If the target is stunned after attacking the enemy on your turn, attacks the target again to absorb its Attack Bar by 50% with an 80% chance. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: Steal ATB from the enemy and add it to yourself
effets.note: If the target is stunned after attacking the enemy on your turn

competences.description: Grants Immunity on yourself for 2 turns if your HP is at 100% at the start of your turn. Otherwise, recovers your HP by 20%. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: The target will gain immunity against all harmful effects.
effets.note: If your HP is at 100% at the start of your turn
If your HP is not 100% at the start of your turn
